paper_title: Repetition Detection in a Dynamic String
statement: We believe that, with due care, our algorithm can be adapted to handle insertions and deletions – the details are omitted due to space constraints. We leave open the questions of whether the runs of a string (or other information sufficient for answering 2-Period Queries in Õ(1) time) can be maintained with Õ(1) time per update and whether period queries for aperiodic substrings can be answered efficiently in a dynamic string.
